reason: Measured on tasks.dense: 8 of 9 card notes carry the word-safe ellipsis at 1279, 1180 and 1100 and 0 of 9 at 1280; at 1100 all 9 titles trim too, and at 1099 the list view (.listBoard/.lrowNote) shows zero ellipses. interaction-check.mjs really does straddle it — lane fit loops [1180,1280,1366,1440], note reading only [1280,1440] — so nothing checks reading at 1180.
sharpenedFix: The diagnosis is right and the remedy is oversized. Lane width at 1279 is 226px and the note measure 149px — identical to 1280 — so the entire cliff is the `@media (min-width: 1280px)` max-height override at src/tasks.css:946-949, not the lane. Patched live: releasing the 5-line cap alone gives 0 of 9 notes and 0 of 9 titles trimmed at 1279 with the board still fitting (0px over). So move that media query's floor to 1200 rather than moving the board/list crossing to 1280 — the proposed 1280 crossing would delete the board across a band where interaction-check.mjs itself asserts 'board @1180 · five lanes fit with nothing sliced', turning a green assertion red. Below 1200 the lane is genuinely too narrow (4 of 9 titles still trim at 1180, 9 of 9 at 1100, board 30px over at 1100), so raise the crossing from 1099 to 1199 — the same threshold the sheet already stamps data-head=stack at — and extend the note loop to [1200, 1279, 1280, 1440].
